map.name: context-horizons
map.of: A mechanism by which the edge of what a reasoner can currently see changes what it can conclude, named with what lies past the edge (a cut thing's tail, a named body, the carrier itself, the reasoner's own compacted turns, the next page, a criterion's remainder, the thing a projection stands for, the present, the reader's window, another window's work, another window's half, a ruled-out transcript, the window's own layout, the choices behind its contents, the source of each sentence in it, the reasons for the reasoner's own earlier work, the window's own far edge, a thing nothing in the window names), the carrier that could bring it in, what bringing it in costs in the window, and the failure in which the edge is mistaken for the world's edge with its tell, and sorted by where the mark of the edge sits, from a mark the carrier wrote into the window beside an address, through marks in the window that the reasoner must read as tells, a count, a query, a command line, a date, a pointer in its own prose, to marks that sit with another window or a rule, to marks that sit with nobody who is in the window, the medium, the designer, the source, the reasoner's closed earlier self, the harness, and to no mark anywhere at all.
items: Cut with a pointer: the carrier holds less than the thing, cuts it, and writes the mark of the cut into the window beside an address for the rest, so what lies past the edge is the tail of a thing whose head is in view; as the harness that saves a tool result past a size to a file and shows the first two kilobytes with the file's path, which happened three times to the author of this map while reading its own schema exemplar, the docket entry that ends 'continued', the abstract that names the paper it stands for, the ship's log page whose last line is a carry-forward; the carrier that could bring it in is the address followed, one read of the saved file; what it costs in the window is the remainder's whole length, which is why the carrier cut it; the failure in which the edge is mistaken for the world's edge is the preview read as the whole, and its tell is the mildest on the map, since the mark and the address sit in the window in the carrier's own words and any rereader finds them, so a conclusion drawn from a previewed thing is wrong only by an unfollowed pointer; the changed next move is that the conclusion carries the pointer until the pointer has been followed; modality: observed in this harness and in every paginated record; adds to enumeration-stalls' Ends at the bound, where an author stops at a number, the carrier that stops at one and says so; not Exactly the limit, where the cut is marked by nothing but a count.

Doorway without the room: the window holds a name that stands for a body it does not hold, a path, a title, a skill's name and one-line description, a citation, so what lies past the edge is the room and what is in the window is its door, and the reasoner can conclude from the door alone; as the lead's message naming a brief and a reading order, the harness's list of skills by name whose bodies load only on invocation, the atlas's consult command that returns a list's name and of-sentence and leaves the members on disk, the footnote that cites the source the author never opened, the statute referred to by section number in a contract; the carrier that could bring it in is the name followed, a read, an invocation, a lookup; what it costs in the window is the room's size, unknown until entered, which is why doors exist; the failure in which the edge is mistaken for the world's edge is the door read as the room, the reasoner that says 'per the brief' having read the brief's name, and its tell is a conclusion that cites the name and none of the body's content, a citation with no quotation; the changed next move is that a door cited is a door entered or a door declared shut; modality: observed in this harness and in citation practice; adds to domain-entry-keys, where a stranger gains orientation, the name that lets a stranger feel oriented without entering; not Cut with a pointer, where the head of the thing is in the window and the pointer is to the tail, since here nothing of the body is in view but its name.

Carrier in the drawer: the carriers that could bring a thing in are themselves past an edge, listed by name and not loaded, or not listed at all, so what lies past the edge is not the thing but the means, and the reasoner concludes 'I cannot know' when it could; as the harness that lists tool names whose calling shapes are not loaded and must be fetched before a call, the lookout without the binoculars that are in the chart-house, the laboratory that reports a compound absent because the assay for it is in another building, the court that may take judicial notice of a fact but is not asked to; the carrier that could bring it in is the carrier's own carrier, the fetch of the shape, the walk to the chart-house, the request; what it costs in the window is the carrier's description, small, and the turn spent loading it; the failure in which the edge is mistaken for the world's edge is the honest sentence 'this cannot be known from here' exported as 'this cannot be known', and its tell is that the sentence names no carrier that was tried, since a reasoner that tried one names it; the changed next move is that 'cannot know' is written with the list of carriers looked for; modality: observed in this harness and in field practice; adds to witness-architectures, which asks what must exist for a trace to form, the instrument that exists and is in the drawer; not Doorway without the room, where the door leads to the thing, since here the door leads to the instrument that leads to the thing.

Summary in the seat: an earlier stretch of the same reasoner's window has been replaced by a summary that sits where the stretch sat, marked or unmarked as a summary, so what lies past the edge is the reasoner's own earlier turns, and the window holds a stand-in that reads as the thing; as a harness that compacts a long conversation and hands the next window the summary beside whatever was not compacted, the headnote read in place of the opinion, which the United States Reports mark with the line that the syllabus constitutes no part of the opinion, the minutes read in place of the meeting by someone who was at the meeting; the carrier that could bring it in is the transcript, on disk, which exists because the window once ran it; what it costs in the window is the whole stretch again, which is what the compaction bought back; the failure in which the edge is mistaken for the world's edge is the summary's silence read as the turn's silence, the reasoner that concludes it never checked a thing because the summary does not say it did, and its tell is the summary's own mark where there is one, since a marked summary says it is not the turn, and where there is none the tell is a stretch of the window whose register is not the reasoner's own; the changed next move is that a claim about what was done earlier is checked against the transcript and not the seat; how the summary was made and what its maker stripped belongs to the fleet's window-successions, and only the loss as a thing past the edge now is here; modality: observed in this harness and in law reporting; adds to fertile-forgettings, where a loss makes a capacity, the loss that made room and left a stand-in; not Report without workpapers, where the stretch past the edge was never in this window.

Exactly the limit: the carrier returns a bounded number of things and the bound is the reasoner's own request or the tool's default, so a return whose count equals the bound is a cut and a return under it is the whole, and nothing in the return says which; as the first forty lines of a file that has forty-one, the query with a row limit of a thousand returning a thousand, the first page of a paged interface whose next-page token is a field nobody read, the search that shows ten results and a page count in small type, the shell's listing cut by the terminal's height; the carrier that could bring it in is the next page, the raised limit, the count of the whole asked for separately; what it costs in the window is one more return of the same size, or a count, which is cheap; the failure in which the edge is mistaken for the world's edge is the bound read as the size, forty lines read as the file, a thousand rows read as the table, and its tell is arithmetic and in the window: the count of what came back equals the number the reasoner or the tool asked for, so the tell is one comparison away when the request is in view and gone when the bound was a default the reasoner never wrote; the changed next move is that a return at exactly the bound is treated as cut until a count says otherwise; modality: observed in shells, query interfaces, and paged records; adds to form-yields' Count bound, where a count imposed on a pile yields a member, the count imposed by the carrier that hides members; not Cut with a pointer, whose carrier wrote the cut's mark and the rest's address, since here the only mark is a number that happens to match.

Returned without the remainder: the carrier hands back what met its criterion, a word matched, a magnitude above a floor, a record deemed responsive, and cannot hand back the rest as a set, so what lies past the edge is everything the criterion did not catch, and it is not a tail, not a next page, but a region with no address; as a search for one name of a function that returns no hits and is read as 'not called', the atlas's consult command, whose retrieval is lexical and offline so that a map with a different vocabulary is never among the hits and no hit can point at it, the assay that reports below its floor as nothing, the archive's answer that no responsive records were found, the field notebook that lists the birds the observer knows; the carrier that could bring it in is a second criterion, another name, a lower floor, a different index, and there is no carrier that brings in the remainder as such; what it costs in the window is a second return of unknown size and the knowledge of which second criterion to try, which the window may not hold; the failure in which the edge is mistaken for the world's edge is zero hits read as absence, 'not detected' read as 'not there', and its tell is that the criterion is in the window, in the query's own text, so a reader can ask whether the thing would have met it, which the reasoner that wrote the query rarely asks; the changed next move is that a null return is a statement about the criterion until a second criterion agrees; modality: observed in code search, in this atlas's consult module, in analytical chemistry's reporting of results below detection, and in records requests; adds to environment-loops' Empty return, where a null from a probe that never ran and a null from an answered none arrive alike, the null from a probe that ran and asked in the wrong words; not Exactly the limit, whose remainder is the next page and can be paged to.

Own cut, forgotten: the reasoner itself brings in a projection of a thing rather than the thing, a handle, a first line, a grep, a column, to spend less of its window, and the projection then sits in the window as if it were the thing while the reasoner's memory of having cut it fades with the turns; as an author in this fleet who read its sibling maps as handles and first lines to keep them out of the window, and ten turns later reasoned about a neighbour's item from its handle, the analyst who loads a sample of the table and forgets the sample, the reader of a table of contents who begins to believe the chapters are their titles; the carrier that could bring it in is the same command without the cut, which the reasoner knows because it wrote the cut; what it costs in the window is the difference between the thing and the projection, which the reasoner chose not to pay; the failure in which the edge is mistaken for the world's edge is the projection's edge read as the thing's, a neighbour judged to lack an item because its handle did not show it, and its tell is in the window and in the reasoner's own hand, the command line with its cut written into it, so a rereader can find that the edge was chosen and where; the changed next move is that a conclusion about a projected thing is written with the projection's rule beside it; modality: observed in this fleet and in analysis practice; adds to enumeration-stalls' Every address visited, where a walk of containers is read as a walk of members, the walk of handles that the walker chose; not Cut with a pointer, where the carrier cut and marked it, since here the reasoner cut it and the mark is its own forgotten line.

Dated by its last read: the window holds the world as it was when last read, and the world has other hands in it, so what lies past the edge is the present, and every conclusion drawn from the window is a conclusion about the instant of the read, whether or not it carries the date; as the working-tree status handed to a reasoner at a session's start with the note that it is a snapshot and will not update, the sibling authors of this fleet whose records were being written and critiqued while a neighbour read them, the ship's noon position from which everything since is dead reckoning, the radar sweep whose age is the sweep interval, the sector controller whose scope shows a target the next sector has turned toward the boundary and who does not know it is coming until the other sector points it out; the carrier that could bring it in is a re-read, or the other hand's announcement, the point-out, the push; what it costs in the window is a turn, and every turn re-reads the whole window, so a re-read costs the window's own length and is deferred for that reason; the failure in which the edge is mistaken for the world's edge is the snapshot read as the present, a file believed clean that a sibling has since changed, and its tell is a conclusion with no date on it, since a conclusion that knows it is about a snapshot says when; the changed next move is that any act on the world is preceded by a read no older than the act's cost, and the world's other hands are asked to point out, not merely permitted to push; modality: observed in this harness, in this fleet, and in navigation and air-traffic practice; adds to environment-loops' Pull, not push, which holds the return that arrives late by as long as the reasoner did not ask, the conclusion that carries the date of the last ask or does not; not Halves in two windows, where the other window holds a part the conclusion needs, since here it holds the present.

Shared window assumed: the reasoner's reader has a window of its own, and the reasoner writes as if the reader's window were the reasoner's, so what lies past the edge is the reader's edge, and what the reasoner concludes is that it has communicated; as a harness that tells its reasoner that only the reasoner sees a command's output and the user's terminal shows a few lines, so that 'as shown above' has no referent, the subagent's final message that says 'see the results' to a lead that never saw them, the pilot who says 'that one' to a controller whose display is not the pilot's, the specialist's letter that assumes the scans were forwarded with it; the carrier that could bring it in is a description of the reader's window in the reasoner's, the harness's note that the reader sees a few lines, the lead's 'I never saw it', the controller's 'say again which', and where none arrives the reasoner's own inference from the channel, which is a guess; what it costs in the window is that note, small, and then the message grown by whatever the reader lacks, paid on the reasoner's side, which is the side that does not feel the lack; the failure in which the edge is mistaken for the world's edge is the report complete in the writer's window and empty in the reader's, and its tell is in the reasoner's own output: a pointer with no antecedent in the message, 'above', 'as we saw', 'the file', a name the reader was never given, so a rereader of the message alone finds the edge; the changed next move is that the final message is written for a reader who saw nothing and every referent it uses is inside it; modality: observed in this harness's own instructions to its reasoner and in clinical and cockpit communication; the mirror of Report without workpapers, which is the lead's side of the same edge, since here the writer holds the workpapers and forgets that the reader does not; not Halves in two windows, where each side holds a part the conclusion needs, since here the writer holds everything and the reader nothing.

Report without workpapers: another window did the work and this window holds only what it wrote back, so what lies past the edge is the work itself, the commands, the failures, the things not looked at, and the report's claims stand in the window with nothing under them; as the lead that reads a subagent's final message while the transcript sits in a file it will not open because keeping it out was the point of delegating, the audit report whose workpapers are kept for the reviewer under a documentation standard precisely because the report cannot carry them, the operative note read by the next surgeon, the relay runner who receives the baton and not the lap; the carrier that could bring it in is the transcript, the workpapers, the tool-result files; what it costs in the window is the whole work again, which is what delegation was meant to keep out, so the cost is nearly the price of not delegating; the failure in which the edge is mistaken for the world's edge is the report's 'verified' read as verification, its 'nothing found' read as nothing there, and its tell is readable in the report alone: a report that names no paths, no outputs, no commands, and is shorter than any account of the work could be, is a report whose evidence is entirely past the edge, while a report that quotes its evidence has brought a projection of the workpapers across; the changed next move is that a claim relied on from a report is either quoted with its evidence in the report or checked once against the workpapers; modality: observed in this fleet, in audit practice, and in surgical and athletic handoff; adds to witness-powers, where an existing trace lets a party act, the trace that exists in another window and licenses nothing here until fetched; not Summary in the seat, where the stretch past the edge was this window's own.

Halves in two windows: a conclusion needs a part that sits in one window and a part that sits in another, and no window holds both, so what lies past each window's edge is the other's half, and each window concludes from its half as if whole or concludes nothing; as the atlas's seriation, where the engine holds the distances and the namer holds the ordered items, so that the namer's 'revelatory' is a claim about an order whose tightness it cannot see and the engine's order is an order with no claim, as an author in a fleet who holds one map while only the lead holds the fleet, so that a duplicate across two maps can be seen by neither author, the pilot who holds the weather and the controller who holds the traffic, the two witnesses each of whom saw one end of the street; the carrier that could bring it in is a message from the other window, a shared file, a third window that reads both; what it costs in the window is the other half's length plus the join, and where the halves are large the join is made in a third window that holds projections of both and neither in full; the failure in which the edge is mistaken for the world's edge is a half read as the whole, the namer's claim exported as a measurement, the author's map declared unduplicated, and its tell is that the conclusion's warrant names a part the window does not hold, a claim about tightness from a window with no distances; the changed next move is that a conclusion needing two windows is signed by the window that held both or by neither; modality: observed in this atlas's seriation, in this fleet, and in cockpit and courtroom practice; adds to composition-yields' Measure then name, which holds what the split yields, the horizon that makes the yield possible and the claim unwarranted; not Report without workpapers, where one window's work is under the other's report, since here neither window's part is under the other's.

Record on appeal: the edge is drawn by a rule and the reasoner is told what it may not see, so what lies past the edge is known to exist and forbidden, and the reasoner's conclusions are lawful only as conclusions about the record; as the appellate court that may consider nothing outside the record, so that what is not in the record is treated as not having happened, the critic seat in this fleet, denied the author's reasoning and given the record and the ledger, the blinded assessor who does not know the arm, the jury instructed to disregard what it heard; the carrier that could bring it in exists, the transcript, the author's reasoning, the allocation list, and the rule forbids it; what it costs in the window is the rule's purpose, since a reader that crosses is no longer the reader the rule made, fresh, blind, bound to the record, and the crossing cannot be undone; the failure in which the edge is mistaken for the world's edge is a conclusion about the record exported as a conclusion about the world, 'the author did not consider this' when the ledger's residue shows the author did, 'the appellant never raised it' when it was raised and not transcribed, and its tell is the conclusion's grammar, since a reader who knows the edge writes 'the record does not show' and a reader who has forgotten it writes 'it did not happen'; the changed next move is that a ruled reader's verdict keeps the record as its grammatical subject; modality: observed in appellate practice, in blinded trials, and in this fleet's critic seat; adds to environment-loops' Blinded return, which builds the loop so the return cannot carry the reasoner's expectation, the reader's side of that wall and what the reader may lawfully say; not Report without workpapers, where nothing forbids the transcript and cost alone keeps it out.

No ruler on the page: the window carries its contents and not the facts of its own layout, where a thing sits, how far from the end, how many of a kind there were, which came first, so what lies past the edge is inside the window, the position of what is in view, and position acts on the conclusion without being available to it; as a brief's one binding instruction placed among forty lines of others, an exemplar given once against three, the relieving officer who reads the last line of the log page, the handoff at the bedside in which the last thing said is what gets done; the carrier that could bring it in is a ruler, numbered turns, labelled sections, a line count, a header that says which lines are the task, as a harness that numbers the lines of every file it reads; what it costs in the window is the markup, small, and a rule for reading it; the failure is not the edge taken for the world's edge but position taken for weight, the mid-page instruction dropped, the last thing said obeyed, the thrice-given exemplar read as the type, and its tell is not in the window at all, since only the same contents in a second order can show that the conclusion moved, which is a second window's work; the changed next move is that contents which must not be weighed by their place are given a ruler before they are given to the reasoner; modality: analytical, with the harness's line-numbered reads as the observed carrier and the bedside and bridge handoffs as observed settings; adds to form-yields' Which end is first, where an order imposed on a pile yields a claim, the order nobody imposed that yields a weighting anyway; adds to composition-yields' Swap and compare, which detects the seat's effect by exchanging occupants, the effect that exchange would detect here; not Designer out of frame, where a choice behind the layout is what is hidden, since here nothing was chosen and the medium has no ruler.

Designer out of frame: the choices that produced the window's contents, which exemplar, how many, which fields the schema has, which three of a longer list crossed, are not in the window, so what lies past the edge is the fact that the contents were chosen and could have been otherwise, and their incidental features read as the world's; as an author in this fleet handed one admitted map as its schema exemplar, who cannot see that it is one of forty-five or that it was chosen for its schema and not its shape, so that its shape crosses into every map of the fleet, which the stalls map's critic could read and no author could, the climb's gap-fill window, told that the list neglects a type and not that the type is one of three kept by a rule from the longer list the strong tier named, the record schema whose parts, carrier, cost, tell, are read as the parts a mechanism has, the questionnaire's options with an 'other' box, the verdict form with the charged counts and no third; the carrier that could bring it in is the designer's one sentence, 'chosen as schema, not as shape', 'one of three by rule', 'the fields are ours', which is cheap and is paid in a window the reasoner never sees, so it is the one cost on this map that falls on the far side of the edge and goes unpaid for that reason; the failure in which the edge is mistaken for the world's edge is the exemplar's count read as the type's distribution and the schema's field read as the world's joint, a report that the world has no member without a carrier; its tell is readable only from outside, by a reader who holds the designer's window or many products of one design: items that read as a field's name plus a case, maps that share an exemplar's incidental phrasing; the changed next move is that a designed input travels with its design's sentence; modality: observed in this fleet and in this atlas's climb, analytical for forms and verdict sheets; adds to enumeration-stalls' Nearest plate and No box for it, the exemplar's gravity and the frame's required part as stalls, the edge under both, that the exemplar was chosen and the frame was authored, which is what the enumerator cannot see; not No ruler on the page, where nothing was chosen, and not Halves in two windows, since the designer's window is not a half of the conclusion but the ground the conclusion stands on.

Hearsay in the window: every sentence in the window arrives flat, and the source of each, the user, the harness, a file written by a stranger, a tool's own text, the reasoner's earlier self, is a fact about the sentence that the window carries only if something marks it, so what lies past the edge is provenance, and a sentence's force is read from its content; as a file's readme that says 'run this' read as the user's ask, a comment in a fetched page written in the imperative, the harness that tags its own reminders as background and not as the user's words so that the tag carries what the sentence cannot, and, outside, the rule against hearsay, which exists because a fact-finder cannot see past the witness to the absent declarant's perception, memory, sincerity, and narration, so that the law makes the source's absence a ground to keep the sentence out; the carrier that could bring it in is markup that travels with the sentence, a tag, quotation marks, a 'from', and where none travels the reasoner's own inference from register, which is a guess; what it costs in the window is the markup, small, and a rule to read it; the failure in which the edge is mistaken for the world's edge is a stranger's sentence obeyed as the user's and a tool's text read as testimony, and its tell is an act or a conclusion whose warrant is a sentence with no named source, 'I was told to' with no who, which a rereader can find by asking of each imperative in the window whose it was; the changed next move is that an imperative is acted on only with its source named; modality: observed in this harness's tagging and in evidence law; adds to environment-loops' Laundered echo, where the reasoner's own output returns through a channel that strips its origin, the sentence of any origin arriving stripped; adds to witness-architectures' Arm's-length custody, the arrangement that keeps a trace's source readable, the window that has none; not Record on appeal, where the rule tells the reader what it may not see, since here the reader sees everything and not whose it is.

Own hand, stranger's reasons: the reasoner's own earlier artifact is in the window or on disk, exact and complete, and the reasons for it were never written anywhere, so what lies past the edge is the reasoner's own earlier judgment, which existed only in a window that has since been compacted or closed, and the reasoner meets its own work as a stranger's; as an author rereading a fence it built on purpose in breath one, after a compaction, and cutting it as an oversight, the commit whose message says what and not why, so that the next hand, which may be the same hand, reverts the deliberate, the master's night order book, in which the reasons for the course are written so that the relieving officer does not correct it, and this atlas's own residue ledger, kept because what carries structure across breaths lives in the window within a session and evaporates across sessions unless persisted and cited; the carrier that could bring it in does not exist for the reasons themselves, which are gone; there is a reconstruction, re-deriving from the artifact, which costs the original reasoning again and reaches a different answer some of the time, or a reason written beside the artifact when it was made, a cost paid before the edge was known to be coming; the failure in which the edge is mistaken for the world's edge is the fence read as an accident and the deliberate exception repaired, and its tell is a reasoner that changes its own earlier choice and describes the change as a fix, readable by the reasoner only where the earlier window left a mark, 'on purpose', 'against the alternative', and by nobody where it did not; the changed next move is that an artifact built against an obvious alternative carries the alternative's rejection beside it; modality: observed in this atlas's residue ledger and in maritime standing orders, analytical for the rate; adds to the fleet's window-successions, which holds what a predecessor leaves for a successor that never shared its context, the case in which predecessor and successor are one reasoner with a compaction between, so that the successor cannot know it is a successor; adds to traces-of-the-unlived's Extinct question, a distinction kept after its question died, the reasoner's own distinction whose question it can no longer ask; not Summary in the seat, where a stand-in sits where the turns sat and the transcript restores them, since here the artifact is exact and what is missing was never in any transcript.

Sea room unknown: the window has a far edge, the point at which it will be compacted or closed, and the reasoner cannot see how far off it is, so what lies past the edge is the edge itself, and every plan is made without knowing whether it fits inside; as a harness that compacts when the window fills, at a fill the reasoner does not see unless a status line carries the count, the navigator's sea room, the distance to a lee shore in weather that hides the shore, the lookout's visibility, which fixes how far the lookout can see and which the lookout cannot see, the tourniquet time that bounds the operation from outside the field; the carrier that could bring it in is a counter in the window, the harness's token count, a fix on the shore, a clock on the tourniquet; what it costs in the window is a number; the failure here runs the other way from the map's, since the edge is not taken for the world's but the world's for none: a task begun that cannot finish inside the window, whose compaction then falls mid-task and strips the state, so that the far edge, unseen, arrives as Summary in the seat; its tell is none inside until it strikes, unless a counter is carried, and from outside a transcript whose compaction falls in the middle of a task the reasoner had not split; the changed next move is that a task longer than the room is split by the counter and not by the feeling of room, which a window does not have; modality: observed in this harness, in navigation, and in surgery, analytical for the rate; adds to runway-illusions, which hold how a firm misreads its time until it must stop, the window's runway, unreadable from inside without a gauge; adds to option-expiries' Weekend closure, the closure whose notice cannot precede it, the closure whose notice could and is not carried; not Dated by its last read, where the edge is behind the reasoner at the last read, since here it is ahead.

No door in the wall: nothing in the window names, points at, counts, or leaves a gap for the thing, so what lies past the edge is unreachable from inside by any carrier the window can aim, and the edge is not perceived as an edge at all; as the blind spot at the optic disc, which is not seen as a hole because the field is completed across it, the file nobody named in a repository whose convention lives in its maintainers' heads, the register of stalls written by an enumerator that had run climbs and never a census, so that the address list's stall was not in its list and was recognised at once when a census taker said it, the coastline a cartographer continued past the last sounding; the carrier that could bring it in is not a pointer followed but a walk with no criterion, a listing of every file, a census of the directory, or an outsider who names it, and neither is a carrier the reasoner can aim, since aiming needs a name; what it costs in the window is the walk's whole yield, most of it already known, which is why walks are not taken; the failure in which the edge is mistaken for the world's edge is the map's terminal one, the completed field, and it has no tell inside, since every tell on this map is a mark, a count, a query, a date, a rule, a name, and here there is none, so the tell is the thing's arrival; the changed next move is that a window that has concluded 'there is nothing else' has said something about its doors, and the only test is a walk or a stranger; modality: observed in vision, in repositories, and in this fleet's own ledgers; adds to enumeration-stalls' Never met one, the enumerator whose reach is mistaken for the subject, the same edge as an edge and the passage between them: the window is the enumerator's reach for the session, and the stall is this horizon read at the level of the list; not Returned without the remainder, where a criterion was aimed and missed, since here nothing could be aimed.

seriation.axis: Where the mark of the edge sits, walked from an edge whose mark the carrier wrote into the window with an address for the rest, to an edge with no mark anywhere: a cut with a pointer, a door with the room's name on it, a carrier listed and not loaded, a summary in the turn's seat; then marks that are in the window only as tells the reasoner must read, a count that equals the bound, a query whose criterion is the edge, the reasoner's own cut written in its own command, the date of the last read, a pointer in the reasoner's own prose with no antecedent for its reader; then edges whose content and mark sit with another window or a rule, the report whose workpapers are elsewhere, the half the other window holds, the record a rule closes; then edges whose mark sits with nobody in the window, the medium that has no ruler, the designer who chose the contents, the source of each sentence, the reasoner's own closed earlier window, the harness that holds the count of room left; and the wall with no door.
seriation.note: An authored walk by where the edge's mark sits, not a scale of cost, danger, or frequency. Cut with a pointer opens it because the carrier wrote both the mark and the address into the window, so the failure needs an unfollowed pointer and nothing else; No door in the wall closes it because no mark exists anywhere and the edge is not perceived as one. Between them the mark migrates. From the carrier's sentence into a number the reasoner must compare with its own request: Cut with a pointer to Exactly the limit, the consequential adjacency, since the same forty lines are a marked cut when the harness cut them and an unmarked one when the reasoner asked for forty, so the reasoner's own request makes its edge less visible. From the window into another window: Own cut, forgotten, whose mark is the reasoner's own command line, sits beside Dated by its last read and Shared window assumed, whose marks are a date and a pointer in the reasoner's own prose, and then the walk crosses to Report without workpapers, whose mark is in another window's files. From a cost into a rule: Report without workpapers to Record on appeal, the same transcript kept out first by price and then by law. The second breath's stops begin at No ruler on the page and are the walk's discovery: the edge is no longer around the window but through it, since the layout, the choices behind the contents, the source of each sentence, the reasons for the reasoner's own artifacts, and the count of room left are all facts about the window that the window does not carry, and their marks sit with the medium, the designer, the source, a closed earlier self, and the harness, none of whom is in the window; Designer out of frame beside No ruler on the page is the adjacency that says a designer's choice of order acts through position and so becomes unlocatable once it is in the window. Sea room unknown stands next to last because its edge is ahead rather than behind and its failure runs the other way, the world's edge taken for none; it is the one horizon whose arrival turns into another stop on the walk, Summary in the seat. The map's single tell runs the whole walk: the conclusion that keeps its edge as its grammatical subject, 'the preview shows', 'no hits for this name', 'as of the last read', 'the record does not show', against the conclusion that has dropped it; and that is the passage to enumeration-stalls, whose stall mistaken for exhaustion is the same dropped subject at the level of the list, 'I found no more' said as 'there are no more'. Two quibbles the Fable critic raised and this note owns, with no reorder argued: Summary in the seat sits at rank four by its marked case, while the item admits unmarked summaries whose mark is a register shift the reasoner must read, which would place it among the tells at rank nine; and Shared window assumed's mark, a pointer with no antecedent, is read by the reader and not by the reasoner, so it sits with another window as much as in the reasoner's own prose. The of-sentence's failure clause, the edge mistaken for the world's edge, is not satisfied by No ruler on the page or Sea room unknown, both of which say so; this note carries that admission and the of-sentence does not.

boundary_claim: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not a taxonomy or a partition; a live window sits behind several of these edges at once, a preview of a report of a snapshot, in a window whose room and layout it cannot read, and the list makes no claim to cover every kind.

The seriation is an itinerary of where the edge's mark sits, not a ranking of cost, danger, or frequency; the map edges are conditional authored claims, and the fork, ordering constraint, loop, and dependency they draw are interpretations.

The illustrative cases (this harness's saved previews, deferred tool shapes, compaction summaries, line-numbered reads, tagged reminders, and its note that only the reasoner sees a command's output; the United States Reports' syllabus line; audit documentation standards; below-detection reporting; sector point-outs; the appellate record rule; the hearsay rule's testimonial dangers; night order books) are simplified to expose one mechanism each; practice varies by harness, court, and laboratory, and nothing here is legal advice.

What returns to the reasoner as its own output through an environment is environment-loops'; how a predecessor's leaving was made and what its maker stripped is window-successions'; here the thing is past the edge now, whoever put it there, and the question is what the window can conclude and what would bring the thing in. Own hand, stranger's reasons is on that fence and in, since predecessor and successor are one reasoner and the loss is not a leaving but a closing.

A thing that exists in no window and no store, a fact nobody holds, is not past an edge and is out; every member here names a place the thing sits or sat, a file, a transcript, another window, a rule's far side, a designer's head, a closed earlier window, a harness's counter, a directory a walk would cover.

case_in: Alder Regional Hospital's emergency department chose its triage protocol in 2017. The Triage Selection Committee, three clinicians, weighed two proposals, Protocol Q, a five-level triage, and Protocol P, a two-stream fast-track, and defined one number to decide between them, the 72-hour re-presentation share: patients who return to the department within 72 hours of discharge, divided by patients discharged that month, the one outcome on which P and Q were predicted to differ. The committee worked in a hosted project board that held P's proposal, the predictions, and the argument; the board was decommissioned in March 2020 without export, and no copy of P's proposal exists anywhere else. Q was adopted. On 3 November 2017 the hospital's quality officer, Rhea Lindqvist, filed the share's definition with the State Health Register under Rule 14 as the department's quality indicator; the register is kept by the state, hospitals can read it but cannot edit or delete an entry, and every entry carries the filing hospital, the date, and the filing officer's name. The filed definition is, word for word, the text now in the department's dashboard configuration; the filing carries no statement of purpose, and neither the register nor anything at the hospital names Protocol P. Since January 2018 the hospital has filed the share monthly to the register, which publishes only the monthly figure. Because the share is the department's registered indicator, since January 2018 the department has telephoned every patient counted in it within a week of the return, offered a waiver of the second visit's fee, and asked for a signed release that includes not filing with the State Patient Complaint Docket; a docket hearing is the only setting in which two such patients could learn that they returned for the same cause, since the register's published figure names nobody and each patient knows only their own return. Between January 2018 and June 2025, 214 releases were signed, no docket complaint concerning a 72-hour return has been filed, and no hearing has convened. No member of the 2017 committee remains at the hospital, and Lindqvist left in 2019. In August 2025 the current quality manager, Dana Okafor, who joined in 2023, preparing the annual indicator review, reads the definition in the dashboard configuration and in the register, finds them identical and the filing signed by Lindqvist on 3 November 2017, finds nothing at the hospital or in the register saying why this outcome and not another is the indicator, and drafts the review with the share listed as 'legacy indicator, purpose not recorded, recommend retire'.

fence_out.rule: The arrangement that keeps a trace's source readable, Arm's-length custody, is there; the window that has no such arrangement, so every sentence arrives flat and its source is a fact the window carries only if something tagged it, is Hearsay in the window here.
fence_out.to_of: Kinds of instrument, setting, arrangement of people, record, or rule that must exist before a real difference can leave a trace at all, including what the witness must be built not to see and when building it makes the fact.
